A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Neural Genetic Search in Discrete Spaces. Their main text, equations, six figures, eight tables, and Appendices A–G are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original NGS experiments on routing, language-model red-teaming, and molecular optimization, including benchmark comparisons and appendix sensitivity analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experiments across all three domains, including quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–8 and analyses in Appendices E–G.

M1.justification: The parent-token crossover, constraint-enforcing and stochastic mutation, rank-based selection/replacement, and domain-specific adaptations remain unchanged. Explicit pretrained-policy notation and the rewritten TSP example clarify the existing procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four routing tasks, TSPLib/CVRPLib-X instances, source/transfer victim models, and ten molecular objectives. Model-based optimization is introduced only as future work, without additional evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments, including routing search methods, language-model decoding baselines, SynNet/SMILES GA/STONED/Graph GA, and the molecular training-only control. Newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix B.2 changes the reported red-teaming stochastic mutation rate from 0.01 to 0.05, while retaining population size 256, offspring size 16, and rank-sampling parameter 0.01. This is a limited reported setting revision; unchanged result tables do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The real-world routing robustness tests, autoregressive-policy experiment, hyperparameter sensitivity studies, alternate-source red-teaming results, and molecular training-versus-search analysis are retained. No substantive analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Section 5.1.2 newly identifies the existing Figure 5 uncertainty bands as ±1 standard deviation across three independent runs and explains that routing table deviations are omitted because they are negligible. The stated run counts and existing uncertainty values remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 and the plotted results in Figures 4–6 retain their entries, numerical values, and trends. For example, Table 4's NGS average remains 0.835. No changed results accompany the revised red-teaming mutation-rate statement.

T1.justification: The probability definitions, crossover/mutation equations, rank and novelty formulas, and Appendix D complexity reasoning retain their substance. Notation is standardized and redundant formulas are removed, without new mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and contribution summary retain the claims of broadly applicable parent-conditioned genetic search improving solution quality and robustness across three domains. The added future-work discussion does not introduce a new demonstrated contribution.

C2.justification: The conclusion newly acknowledges the absence of guarantees for generated distributions or convergence to optimal solutions. It also proposes using population diversity to improve robustness to inaccurate model-based optimization proxies, while retaining the existing policy-quality and hyperparameter limitations.

D1.justification: Section 5 adds a direct NGS code-access link. Appendix B.2 revises the mutation-rate specification and removes the explicit temperature-1 example for top-k/top-p baselines. Hardware, training procedures, and other substantive implementation disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Kim et al. (2023) for rank-based sampling and five model-based optimization references: Trabucco et al. (2021), Yu et al. (2021), Chen et al. (2022; 2023b), and Reddy et al. (2024). These support a localized future-work extension; the central related-work positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized edits clarify GA components, pretrained-policy notation, and the TSP explanation. v2 adds Future works, Impact Statement, and Acknowledgements text, updates affiliations/publication information, and fixes small wording errors while retaining the overall organization.

P2.justification: Captions for Figures 1–3 are revised, particularly to explain crossover, mutation, and color meanings. Text reflow changes display positions, but the figure graphics and table structures are retained, with no added or removed displays.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity through clearer algorithm explanations and captions, explicit interpretation of existing uncertainty bands, a direct code-access link, and acknowledgment of missing theoretical guarantees. The empirical evidence remains unchanged. The unexplained mutation-rate revision leaves some reproducibility ambiguity, limiting the gains, but the documentation and qualification improvements support a modest overall improvement.
